SELECT t.dept_name as district, t.dept_code as district_code, IFNULL(m.proj_nums, 0) as proj_nums, IFNULL(n.proj_nums, 0) as last_year_proj_nums, CASE WHEN IFNULL(n.proj_nums, 0) = 0 THEN '-' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(((IFNULL(m.proj_nums, 0) - IFNULL(n.proj_nums, 0)) / IFNULL(n.proj_nums, 0)) * 100, 2), '%') END as proj_tb, IFNULL(ROUND(m.qyje, 2), 0) as ztz, IFNULL(ROUND(n.qyje, 2), 0) as last_ztz, CASE WHEN IFNULL(ROUND(n.qyje, 2), 0) = 0 THEN '-' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND(((IFNULL(ROUND(m.qyje, 2), 0) - IFNULL(ROUND(n.qyje, 2), 0)) / IFNULL(ROUND(n.qyje, 2), 0)) * 100, 2)) END as ztz_tb, IFNULL(x.nz_proj_num, 0) as nz_proj_num, IFNULL(ROUND(x.nz_tz, 2), 0) as nz_tz, IFNULL(x.wz_proj_num, 0) as wz_proj_num, IFNULL(ROUND(x.wz_tz, 2), 0) as wz_tz, IFNULL(h.ndmbrws, 0) as ndmbrws, CASE WHEN IFNULL(h.ndmbrws, 0) = 0 THEN '-' ELSE CONCAT(ROUND((IFNULL(m.proj_nums, 0) / IFNULL(h.ndmbrws, 0)) * 100, 2), '%') END as ndmbwcl FROM t_common_dept t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT district_code, district, COUNT(1) as proj_nums, SUM(qyje) as qyje FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 0.05 AND invest_money < 1) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 50 AND invest_money < 1000))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= #{rmb}) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= #{dollar}))
AND signed_stat_date >= #{currStartDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{currEndDate} GROUP BY district_code, district ) m ON t.dept_code = m.district_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT district_code, district, COUNT(1) as proj_nums, SUM(qyje) as qyje FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 0.05 AND invest_money < 1) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 50 AND invest_money < 1000))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= #{rmb}) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= #{dollar}))
AND signed_stat_date >= #{lastYearStartDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{lastYearEndDate} GROUP BY district_code, district ) n ON t.dept_code = n.district_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT district_code,
SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 0.05 AND invest_money < 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as nz_proj_num, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 0.05 AND invest_money < 1 THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) as nz_tz, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 50 AND invest_money < 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wz_proj_num, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 50 AND invest_money < 1000 THEN IFNULL(invest_money, 0) ELSE 0 END) / 10000 as wz_tz
SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= #{rmb} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as nz_proj_num, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= #{rmb} THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) as nz_tz, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= #{dollar} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wz_proj_num, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= #{dollar} THEN IFNULL(invest_money, 0) ELSE 0 END) / 10000 as wz_tz
FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1)) AND signed_stat_date >= #{currStartDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{currEndDate} GROUP BY district_code ) x ON t.dept_code = x.district_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT district_code, CASE WHEN #{rmb} = 1 THEN SUM(one_count) WHEN #{rmb} = 5 THEN SUM(five_count) WHEN #{rmb} = 10 THEN SUM(ten_count) ELSE 0 END as ndmbrws FROM t_proj_task WHERE b_year = YEAR(#{currStartDate}) AND sfqx = 1 GROUP BY district_code ) h ON t.dept_code = h.district_code WHERE t._code IS NOT NULL AND t._code != '' AND t.dept_status = true AND t.deleted = false ORDER BY t.dept_code

SELECT t.dept_name as district, t.dept_code as district_code, IFNULL(m.proj_nums, 0) as proj_nums, IFNULL(n.proj_nums, 0) as last_year_proj_nums, CASE WHEN IFNULL(n.proj_nums, 0) = 0 THEN '-' ELSE ROUND(((IFNULL(m.proj_nums, 0) - IFNULL(n.proj_nums, 0)) / IFNULL(n.proj_nums, 0)) * 100, 2) END as proj_tb, IFNULL(ROUND(m.qyje, 2), 0) as ztz, IFNULL(ROUND(n.qyje, 2), 0) as last_ztz, CASE WHEN IFNULL(ROUND(n.qyje, 2), 0) = 0 THEN '-' ELSE ROUND(((IFNULL(ROUND(m.qyje, 2), 0) - IFNULL(ROUND(n.qyje, 2), 0)) / IFNULL(ROUND(n.qyje, 2), 0)) * 100, 2) END as ztz_tb, IFNULL(x.nz_proj_num, 0) as nz_proj_num, IFNULL(ROUND(x.nz_tz, 2), 0) as nz_tz, IFNULL(x.wz_proj_num, 0) as wz_proj_num, IFNULL(ROUND(x.wz_tz, 2), 0) as wz_tz, h.ndmbrws as ndmbrws, '-' as ndmbwcl FROM (select dept_code ,dept_name from t_common_dept where dept_type = '3' and dept_status = 1 and dept_code like concat(#{deptCode},'%')) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT zone_code, COUNT(1) as proj_nums, SUM(qyje) as qyje FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 0.05 AND invest_money < 1) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 50 AND invest_money < 1000))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= #{rmb}) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= #{dollar}))
AND signed_stat_date >= #{currStartDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{currEndDate} GROUP BY zone_code ) m ON t.dept_code = m.zone_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT zone_code, COUNT(1) as proj_nums, SUM(qyje) as qyje FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 0.05 AND invest_money < 1) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 50 AND invest_money < 1000))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= #{rmb}) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= #{dollar}))
AND signed_stat_date >= #{lastYearStartDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{lastYearEndDate} GROUP BY zone_code ) n ON t.dept_code = n.zone_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT zone_code,
SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 0.05 AND invest_money < 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as nz_proj_num, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 0.05 AND invest_money < 1 THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) as nz_tz, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 50 AND invest_money < 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wz_proj_num, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 50 AND invest_money < 1000 THEN IFNULL(invest_money, 0) ELSE 0 END) / 10000 as wz_tz
SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= #{rmb} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as nz_proj_num, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= #{rmb} THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) as nz_tz, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= #{dollar} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wz_proj_num, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= #{dollar} THEN IFNULL(invest_money, 0) ELSE 0 END) / 10000 as wz_tz
FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1)) AND signed_stat_date >= #{currStartDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{currEndDate} GROUP BY zone_code ) x ON t.dept_code = x.zone_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT zone_code as district_code, case when #{rmb}=1 then sum(one_count) when #{rmb} =5 then sum(five_count) when #{rmb} =10 then sum(ten_count) else 0 end as ndmbrws from t_proj_task where b_year = YEAR(#{currStartDate}) and sfqx=2 GROUP BY zone_code ) h on h.district_code = t.dept_code ORDER BY t.dept_code

SELECT district_code, district, COUNT(1) as proj_nums, ROUND(SUM(qyje), 2) as ztz FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 0.05 AND invest_money < 1) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 50 AND invest_money < 1000))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= #{rmb}) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= #{dollar}))
AND signed_stat_date >= #{startDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY district_code, district

SELECT d.district_code, d.district, COUNT(p.id) as proj_nums, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(p.qyje), 0), 2) as ztz FROM ( SELECT dept_code as district_code, dept_name as district FROM t_common_dept WHERE _code IS NOT NULL AND _code != '' AND dept_status = 1 ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, qyje, district_code FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 0.05 AND invest_money < 1) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 50 AND invest_money < 1000))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= #{rmb}) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= #{dollar}))
AND signed_stat_date >= #{startDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{endDate} ) p ON d.district_code = p.district_code GROUP BY d.district_code, d.district

SELECT CONCAT(district_code, '_', r_progress) as code, district_code, r_progress as progress, COUNT(1) as proj_nums, ROUND(SUM(qyje), 2) as ztz FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND r_progress in (1,2,4,5)
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 0.05 AND invest_money < 1) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 50 AND invest_money < 1000))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= #{rmb}) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= #{dollar}))
AND signed_stat_date >= #{startDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY district_code, r_progress

SELECT m._code as projType, COUNT(n.id) as proj_nums, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(n.qyje), 2), 0) as ztz FROM t_proj_type m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT id, qyje, proj_type FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 0.05 AND invest_money < 1) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 50 AND invest_money < 1000))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= #{rmb}) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= #{dollar}))
AND signed_stat_date >= #{startDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{endDate} ) n ON n.proj_type LIKE CONCAT(m._code, '%') WHERE m.deleted = false AND m.level = 1 GROUP BY m._code

SELECT CONCAT(m.district_code, '_', n.code) as projType, COUNT(m.id) as proj_nums, ROUND(SUM(m.qyje), 2) as ztz FROM ( SELECT id, district_code, qyje, proj_type FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 0.05 AND invest_money < 1) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 50 AND invest_money < 1000))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= #{rmb}) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= #{dollar}))
AND signed_stat_date >= #{startDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{endDate} ) m JOIN ( SELECT _code code FROM t_proj_type WHERE deleted = false AND level = 2 ) n ON m.proj_type LIKE CONCAT(n.code, '%') GROUP BY m.district_code, n.code

SELECT CONCAT(m.zone_code, '_', n.code) as projType, COUNT(m.id) as proj_nums, ROUND(SUM(m.qyje), 2) as tze FROM ( SELECT id, zone_code, qyje, proj_type FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 0.05 AND invest_money < 1) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 50 AND invest_money < 1000))
AND ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= #{rmb}) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= #{dollar}))
AND signed_stat_date >= #{startDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{endDate} ) m JOIN ( SELECT _code code FROM t_proj_type WHERE deleted = false AND level = 2 ) n ON m.proj_type LIKE CONCAT(n.code, '%') JOIN t_common_dept z ON m.zone_code = z.dept_code WHERE z.dept_code LIKE CONCAT(#{deptCode}, '%') AND z.deleted = false and z.dept_type = 3 and z.dept_status = 1 GROUP BY m.zone_code, n.code

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.p_type = 1 AND m.invest_money >= #{rmb} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as nz_proj_nums, SUM(CASE WHEN m.p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(m.invest_money, 0) >= #{dollar} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wz_proj_nums, SUM(CASE WHEN m.p_type = 1 AND m.invest_money >= #{rmb} THEN m.qyje ELSE 0 END) as nz_tz, SUM(CASE WHEN m.p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(m.invest_money, 0) >= #{dollar} THEN m.qyje ELSE 0 END) as wz_tz FROM t_proj_project_signed m JOIN ( SELECT dept_code FROM t_biz_zone WHERE key_zone = true AND deleted = false ) n ON m.zone_code = n.dept_code WHERE m.deleted = false AND (m.progress > 0 OR (m.progress = 0 AND m.check_status = 1)) AND m.signed_stat_date >= #{startDate} AND m.signed_stat_date <= #{endDate}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(xqyxmsOne), 0) as xqyxmsOne, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(xqytzeOne), 0), 2) as xqytzeOne, IFNULL(SUM(xqyxmsFive), 0) as xqyxmsFive, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(xqytzeFive), 0), 2) as xqytzeFive, IFNULL(SUM(xqyxmsTen), 0) as xqyxmsTen, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(xqytzeTen), 0), 3) as xqytzeTen, IFNULL(SUM(nzxqyxmsOne), 0) as nzxqyxmsOne, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(nzxqytzeOne), 0), 2) as nzxqytzeOne, IFNULL(SUM(wzxqyxmsOne), 0) as wzxqyxmsOne, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(wzxqytzeOne), 0), 2) as wzxqytzeOne FROM ( SELECT district_code, SUM(CASE WHEN ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 1) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 1000)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as xqyxmsOne, SUM(CASE WHEN ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 1) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 1000)) THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) as xqytzeOne, SUM(CASE WHEN ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 5) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 3000)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as xqyxmsFive, SUM(CASE WHEN ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 5) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 3000)) THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) as xqytzeFive, SUM(CASE WHEN ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 10) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 10000)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as xqyxmsTen, SUM(CASE WHEN ((p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 10) OR (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 10000)) THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) as xqytzeTen, SUM(CASE WHEN (p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as nzxqyxmsOne, SUM(CASE WHEN (p_type = 1 AND invest_money >= 1) THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) as nzxqytzeOne, SUM(CASE WHEN (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 1000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wzxqyxmsOne, SUM(CASE WHEN (p_type = 2 AND invest_money >= 1000) THEN invest_money / 10000 ELSE 0 END) as wzxqytzeOne FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1)) AND signed_stat_date >= #{currStartDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{currEndDate} GROUP BY district_code ) x

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 1 AND qyje >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as nz_proj_nums, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) >= 3000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wz_proj_nums, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 1 AND qyje >= 5 THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) as nz_tz, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) >= 3000 THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) as wz_tz, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) >= 3000 THEN IFNULL(invest_money, 0) ELSE 0 END) / 10000 as wz_tz_dollar FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1)) AND signed_stat_date >= #{startDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{endDate}

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 1 AND qyje >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as nz_proj_nums, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) / 10000 >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wz_proj_nums, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 1 AND qyje >= 10 THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) as nz_tz, SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) / 10000 >= 1 THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) as wz_tz FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1)) AND signed_stat_date >= #{startDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{endDate}

SELECT m.dept_code as district_code, m.dept_name as district, IFNULL(t.one_count, 0) as one_task_count, IFNULL(t.five_count, 0) as five_task_count, IFNULL(t.ten_count, 0) as ten_task_count, IFNULL(n.one_count, 0) as one_count, IFNULL(n.five_count, 0) as five_count, IFNULL(n.ten_count, 0) as ten_count FROM ( SELECT dept_code, dept_name FROM t_common_dept WHERE _code IS NOT NULL AND _code != '' AND dept_status = 1 AND deleted = false ) m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT district_code, SUM(CASE WHEN (p_type = 1 AND qyje >= 1) OR (p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) >= 1000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as one_count, SUM(CASE WHEN (p_type = 1 AND qyje >= 5) OR (p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) >= 3000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as five_count, SUM(CASE WHEN (p_type = 1 AND qyje >= 10) OR (p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) / 10000 >= 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ten_count FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1)) AND signed_stat_date >= #{startDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY district_code ) n ON m.dept_code = n.district_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT district_code, SUM(one_count) as one_count, SUM(five_count) as five_count, SUM(ten_count) as ten_count FROM t_proj_task WHERE b_year = #{year} AND sfqx = 1 AND deleted = false GROUP BY district_code ) t ON m.dept_code = t.district_code

SELECT n.dept_code AS districtCode, n.dept_name AS district, (IFNULL(m.score_five, 0) + IFNULL(m.score_ten, 0) + IFNULL(t.score, 0)) AS scorePlus FROM ( SELECT dept_code, dept_name FROM t_common_dept WHERE dept_code IS NOT NULL AND _code != '' AND dept_status = 1 AND deleted = false ) n LEFT JOIN ( SELECT district_code, SUM(CASE WHEN (p_type = 1 AND qyje >= 50 AND qyje < 100) OR (p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) / 10000 >= 5 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) / 10000 <= 10) THEN 0.2 ELSE 0 END) AS score_five, SUM(CASE WHEN (p_type = 1 AND qyje >= 100) OR (p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) / 10000 >= 10) THEN 0.3 ELSE 0 END) AS score_ten FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1)) AND signed_stat_date >= #{currStartDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{currEndDate} GROUP BY district_code ) m ON n.dept_code = m.district_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT district_code, SUM(score) AS score FROM t_proj_score WHERE year = #{year} AND `month` BETWEEN #{startMonth} AND #{endMonth} GROUP BY district_code ) t ON n.dept_code = t.district_code ORDER BY n.dept_code

SELECT t.dept_code AS zoneCode, t.name AS zoneName, t.gear AS gear, (IFNULL(n.score_five, 0) + IFNULL(n.score_ten, 0) + IFNULL(s.score, 0)) AS scorePlus FROM ( SELECT dept_code, _name name, gear FROM t_biz_zone WHERE key_zone = 1 AND deleted = false ) t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT zone_code, SUM(CASE WHEN (p_type = 1 AND qyje >= 50 AND qyje < 100) OR (p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) / 10000 >= 5 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) / 10000 <= 10) THEN 0.2 ELSE 0 END) AS score_five, SUM(CASE WHEN (p_type = 1 AND qyje >= 100) OR (p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) / 10000 >= 10) THEN 0.3 ELSE 0 END) AS score_ten FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1)) AND signed_stat_date >= #{currStartDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{currEndDate} GROUP BY zone_code ) n ON t.dept_code = n.zone_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT zone_code, SUM(score) AS score FROM t_proj_score WHERE year = #{year} AND `month` BETWEEN #{startMonth} AND #{endMonth} GROUP BY zone_code ) s ON t.dept_code = s.zone_code ORDER BY t.dept_code

SELECT m.dept_code AS zoneCode, m.name AS zoneName, m.gear AS gear, IFNULL(t.one_count, 0) AS oneTaskCount, IFNULL(t.five_count, 0) AS fiveTaskCount, IFNULL(t.ten_count, 0) AS tenTaskCount, IFNULL(n.one_count, 0) AS oneCount, IFNULL(n.five_count, 0) AS fiveCount, IFNULL(n.ten_count, 0) AS tenCount FROM ( SELECT dept_code, _name name , gear FROM t_biz_zone WHERE key_zone = 1 AND deleted = false ) m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT zone_code, one_count, five_count, ten_count FROM t_proj_task WHERE b_year = #{year} AND sfqx = 2 AND deleted = false ) t ON m.dept_code = t.zone_code LEFT JOIN ( SELECT zone_code, SUM(CASE WHEN (p_type = 1 AND qyje >= 1) OR (p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) >= 1000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS one_count, SUM(CASE WHEN (p_type = 1 AND qyje >= 5) OR (p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) >= 3000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS five_count, SUM(CASE WHEN (p_type = 1 AND qyje >= 10) OR (p_type = 2 AND IFNULL(invest_money, 0) / 10000 >= 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ten_count FROM t_proj_project_signed WHERE deleted = false AND (progress > 0 OR (progress = 0 AND check_status = 1)) AND signed_stat_date >= #{currStartDate} AND signed_stat_date <= #{currEndDate} GROUP BY zone_code ) n ON m.dept_code = n.zone_code ORDER BY m.dept_code

SELECT name, px, SUM(CASE WHEN district = '靖江市' THEN total_num ELSE 0 END) AS jjsNum, SUM(CASE WHEN district = '靖江市' THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) AS jjsQyje, SUM(CASE WHEN district = '泰兴市' THEN total_num ELSE 0 END) AS txsNum, SUM(CASE WHEN district = '泰兴市' THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) AS txsQyje, SUM(CASE WHEN district = '兴化市' THEN total_num ELSE 0 END) AS xhsNum, SUM(CASE WHEN district = '兴化市' THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) AS xhsQyje, SUM(CASE WHEN district = '海陵区' THEN total_num ELSE 0 END) AS hlqNum, SUM(CASE WHEN district = '海陵区' THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) AS hlqQyje, SUM(CASE WHEN district = '姜堰区' THEN total_num ELSE 0 END) AS jyqNum, SUM(CASE WHEN district = '姜堰区' THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) AS jyqQyje, SUM(CASE WHEN district = '医药高新区(高港区)' THEN total_num ELSE 0 END) AS yygxqNum, SUM(CASE WHEN district = '医药高新区(高港区)' THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) AS yygxqQyje, SUM(CASE WHEN district in ('医药高新区(高港区)','靖江市','泰兴市','兴化市','海陵区','姜堰区') THEN total_num ELSE 0 END) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN district in ('医药高新区(高港区)','靖江市','泰兴市','兴化市','海陵区','姜堰区') THEN qyje ELSE 0 END) AS totalQyje FROM ( -- 原查询（确保每个区域和类型都有记录，包括 0 值） SELECT pt.name, pt.px, COALESCE(SUM(a.num), 0) AS total_num, COALESCE(SUM(a.qyje), 0) AS qyje, d.district FROM (SELECT dept_code AS district_code, dept_name AS district FROM t_common_dept WHERE _code IS NOT NULL AND _code != '' AND dept_status = 1) d CROSS JOIN (SELECT name, px, code FROM ls_proj_type) pt LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.name, a.px, b.district_code, COUNT(1) AS num, sum(qyje) qyje FROM ls_proj_type a JOIN t_proj_project_signed b ON a.code LIKE CONCAT('%', b.proj_type, '%') WHERE b._status = 1 AND (b.progress > 0 OR (b.progress = 0 AND b.check_status = 1)) AND b.proj_type != 2 and b.signed_stat_date >= #{currStartDate} and b.signed_stat_date <= #{currEndDate}
AND ((b.p_type = 1 AND b.invest_money >= 0.05 AND b.invest_money < 1) OR (b.p_type = 2 AND b.invest_money >= 50 AND b.invest_money < 1000))
AND ((b.p_type = 1 AND b.invest_money >= #{rmb}) OR (b.p_type = 2 AND b.invest_money >= #{dollar}))
GROUP BY a.name, a.px, b.district_code ) a ON d.district_code = a.district_code AND pt.name = a.name GROUP BY pt.name, pt.px, d.district,a.qyje ) AS subquery -- 按项目和优先级分组 GROUP BY name, px -- 按优先级排序 ORDER BY px
